Containers.Name: SmokeSignal (renamed to FireSquire)
Containers.Overview:
This plugin has been renamed to FireSquire.
Same pre-reboot GO / CAUTION / NO-GO advisory, same read-only engine, new medieval-flavored name to match the rest of the house. If you have SmokeSignal installed, uninstall it and install FireSquire instead - search for FireSquire in the Apps tab, or see https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/firesquire
This entry receives no further updates beyond this notice.
